6959.d: Ees paremal künkal kaks istuvat figuuri. Vasakul nende poole sammuv mees. Paremal, pisut tagapool, kõrge küngas üksiku puuga, selle ees, vee ääres hoone (veski).
6959.de: In front, on the right, on a hillock, two seated figures. To the left, a man walking towards them. On the right, a little further back, a high hillock with a solitary tree, in front of it, by the water, a building (a mill).

7737.d: Eest taha suunduva jõe künklikel kallastel vasakul: üksikuid hooneid, mägede taustal, paremal asula kirikuhoonega. Keset jõge neem kindluse müüride ja torniga. Taevas pilvistatud.
7737.de: On the hilly banks of a river receding from front to back, on the left: individual buildings, against a background of mountains, on the right a settlement with a church building. In the middle of the river a headland with fortress walls and a tower. The sky is clouded.

10104.d: Künklik rannaäärne suvemaastik karjaga - vasakul kolm lehma ja kaugemal üks lammas; keskel kaks lammast tallega. Paremal üle oru, künka otsas hooneid. Taamal suurem veekogu.
10104.de: A hilly coastal summer landscape with livestock - on the left three cows and further away one sheep; in the middle two sheep with a lamb. On the right, across a valley, buildings on top of a hill. In the distance a larger body of water.
